verdict.rationale: Airwallex Transfers and Batch Transfers docs explicitly support moving funds to suppliers/vendors and bank accounts, including bulk supplier payments and reconciliation, plus Bills API for vendor invoices — covering domestic AP payment workflows. Missing for 10: explicit mention of ACH/wire as named payment rails (docs describe generic 'bank transfers' and 'local payment methods' without specifying ACH vs wire) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
